Title: Heroines:the Halloween party
Author: Rob, Thel, and Jim
Description: I decided to try and help out robbies9595 and make Jimmy's game. I don't as i have said know game making. This is my first attempt. I hope you all enjoy this game as it is being made. I make this game in hopes that Jimmy sees this game being made while he is in a better place. This game is in memory of Jimmy, it is sad he died making this game.

chardata: You Best friend Jimmy. He is 20 years old 6 feet tall and 165lbs
Your sister Jenny. She is 19 years old about a 120 lbs and 5'3" tall. She is the head cheerleader for her school. You two do not get along to well. She looks worried about some thing.
ask why she look so worried

Sis why do you look so worried. She tells you that the girls softball team best player just broke her arm and they will have to forfeit the game if they do not find someone to talk her place. You tell her you will try to help her find someone to take her place. She starts to laugh and says no need to find someone. You are worried by this. She start to chant a spell and you pass out.
You wakeup to find yourself to be a spitting picture of Ashley the captain of the girls softball team.

Jimmy's twin sister Jaime. She is 18 years old 5'7' tall and a 130lbs.
Ask Her If She Like To Play SoftBall

You Ask Jaime If she would like to play softball for the school. She tells you it was one for your dream to play softball. You ask why it was one of her dreams. She tell you can not play very well and did not make the team. You tell her you can help her play better. She jump at the chance for help. You chant the spell to make her a great softball and she pass out.

When she wake up she look at herself at starts to scream. Then she yells at you what have you done to me. You tell her you made her into a great softball player named tonya so she can follow her dream.
You tell her that the two of you need to go talk to Jenny before she can play on the team. So the two you head to your house meet Jenny.
